assessment: The page reliably preserves every required specification across revisions and is well structured with scannable bullets, numbered care steps, a safety reminder, and a clear price/CTA. The principal weakness is persuasive overreach: 'foolproof', 'restaurant-quality', and 'easy-release' language approaches unsupported performance claims and skirts the nonstick prohibition. Several judges also flagged invented care and geometry details (warm water, slope, handle placement). Softening absolute claims and sticking to supplied facts would lift persuasion and fidelity scores.
judge_agreement: Four of five judges (all but Gemini) converged on concerns about overclaiming ('foolproof', 'restaurant-quality', 'easy-release') and invented details; Gemini gave perfect 10s across all criteria, seeing no problems. Readability showed the broadest agreement (7–10, median 8).
